'''Kainea''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Appearance ==
She has dark hair.

== Activities ==
[[Rand al'Thor]] asks her to gather some messengers for him when everyone is assembled in the courtyard of the [[Stone of Tear]].
== Trivia ==
* Kainea is named for Sarah Kainec, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
